name: netudp_nomod
description: Without the network modules there is no UDP: socket(AF_INET, SOCK_DGRAM) answers EPROTONOSUPPORT, as 2.11BSD's socreate does when no protosw matches, and never opens one of the W5100's hardware sockets.  The release /etc/rc less the network modules on its modload line (fixtures/rc.netlate) is staged, and loopprobe -n asks for one socket.
